---
title: "Installation"
guide-section: "Get started"
description: "Install cane-format from PyPI."
---

`cane-format` needs Python 3.10 or newer and has no dependencies.

```bash
pip install cane-format
```

With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
uv add cane-format
```

Import it under its short name:

```python
import cane_format as cane
```

The command line tool `cane-format` is installed with the package:

```bash
cane-format --help
```

:::{.callout-note}
## Versions

`cane-format` follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/). While the version starts
with `0.`, the API may still change between minor releases; every change is listed in the
[changelog](https://github.com/coree/cane-format/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
:::
